definitions.short: Baana , the name of four Israelite
definitions.full: H1195. Baana בַּעֲנָא proper name, masculine (? בֶּןעָֿנָה son of distress ) — 1 name of two officers of Solomon , a. 1Kin 4:12 ; b. 1Kin 4:16 . 2 father (ancestor) of an Israelite of Nehemiah's time Neh 3:4 compare following

occurrences.englishText: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;
Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;

Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel made repairs. Next to them, Zadok the son of Baana made repairs.
